NVIDIA's investment in optical technology company Coherent involved approximately $2 billion in funding tied to a strategic partnership for artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Coherent issued approximately 7.8 million shares to NVIDIA at $256.80 per share. The transaction was accompanied by a multiyear agreement involving advanced optics and networking components.

The agreement included purchase commitments and access to product families relevant to co-packaged optics, a technology used to move data efficiently in large AI systems.

This account restates the investment terms and partnership already described in the original report, without claiming any subsequent transaction.
headline: Coherent raises $2 billion from NVIDIA in strategic optical partnership
summary: Coherent issued 7.8 million shares to NVIDIA at $256.80 per share under a multiyear optical agreement.
